candidates.decision_relevance: Would let reviewers compare the move, rebound, and drawdown with what was observable at each analysis freeze, rather than infer sequence from weekly endpoints or overlapping return windows.
candidates.evidence_reference: Weekly reviews repeatedly lack numerical intrawweek paths and aligned freeze-time observations; daily reviews also report unavailable or incorrectly anchored nominal horizons.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamped BTC, ETH, and ETH/BTC price path with actual window boundaries
candidates.missing_history_problem: Weekly endpoint summaries cannot test path ordering or recovery magnitude. In daily captures, nominal horizons sometimes lack valid anchors or cover materially different actual spans, making sequence comparisons ambiguous.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would show whether participation weakness or recovery persisted and whether it preceded or followed price moves, helping distinguish a transient endpoint reading from a sustained change.
candidates.evidence_reference: Reviews repeatedly describe proxy breadth as a single observation or compare captures with different constituent membership; canonical breadth is often unconfirmed.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamped breadth observations with constituent universe and membership
candidates.missing_history_problem: Point-in-time proxy counts and changing membership do not establish a comparable historical breadth path, persistence, or timing relative to price deterioration.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would establish whether reported positive or negative settled flows were isolated sessions or part of a persistent sequence, and align flow evidence with price and breadth observations.
candidates.evidence_reference: Multiple reviews rely on the latest settled session while noting that subsequent sessions or the weekly flow sequence are absent; W44 has no settled-flow rows in the supplied analysis.
candidates.metric_name: Per-session settled BTC and ETH ETF flow totals with session dates
candidates.missing_history_problem: Single-session observations, stale rows, and missing sessions leave flow persistence and within-review-period sequencing unresolved; absent sessions must not be inferred from older totals.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would permit evaluation of forecast precision and warning-time sequence against outcomes available after each freeze, without treating retrospective summaries or overlapping cohorts as validation.
candidates.evidence_reference: Reviews repeatedly report missing candidate bounds, issue times, numerical paths, and candidate-linked matured outcomes; protection observations are overlapping and descriptive.
candidates.metric_name: Freeze-linked candidate specifications and subsequent realized metric paths
candidates.missing_history_problem: Without preserved issue-time targets, bounds, horizons, and aligned realized paths, broad-range containment, path accuracy, and post-warning outcomes cannot be audited or separated from hindsight.
